reviews.text: Eric did a fantastic job painting our hall, stairs and landing. He is a very pleasant guy, easy to get along with and have in your home. Can definitely recommend him and will use his service again.
reviews.author: Jan Ruse

reviews.text: I got Eric to paint my hall, stairs and landing. He was punctual, did a great job, was tidy and completed on time. Thoroughly nice man as well.
